newsitem.title: FINLAND: CULTOR 4-MTH PROFIT SEEN AT FIM 60 MLN.
newsitem.headline: CULTOR 4-MTH PROFIT SEEN AT FIM 60 MLN.

text.p: Some Finnish equities analysts revised their forecasts for foodstuffs, animal feed and bakery group Cultor Oy's four-month profit after the company said last week that some forecasts were not in line with what it has said.
Cultor on March 21 pointed to comments made on April 11 by group CEO Bjorn Mattson that the performance in the first tertial would be at the year-ago level.

A Reuters poll had found a median forecast January-April profit before extraordinary items and tax of 101 million markka in a 50-133 million markka range while Cultor's January-April 1996 profit was 49 million markka.
The median of nine analysts' forecasts in a new poll made after Cultor's comments on the previous poll was 60 million markka in a 50-75 million markka range.
